children: PermRock Royalty Trust declared a monthly cash distribution of $238,742.30 (or $0.0196242 per trust unit) payable October 15, 2026 to holders of record as of September 30, 2026, based principally on production during July 2026. The distribution reflects oil receipts of approximately $1.25 million, natural gas receipts of about $0.02 million and other revenue of $0.11 million, with total direct operating expenses of $0.66 million. Capital expenditures totaled $116,596 and the net profits calculation included a $62,500 net release from previously reserved funds.
Monthly distribution declared: $238,742.30 total; $0.0196242 per trust unit (payable October 15, 2026; record date September 30, 2026).
Oil cash receipts for the period: approximately $1.25 million.
Natural gas cash receipts for the period: approximately $0.02 million.
Other revenue for the period: $0.11 million (includes salt water disposal income; reclassified from offset to lease operating expenses).
Total direct operating expenses (marketing, lease operating, workover): $0.66 million.
Underlying oil sales volumes for the current month (used in net profits): 15,632 barrels (504 Bbls/D), a decrease from the prior month.
Underlying natural gas sales volumes for the current month: 19,662 Mcf (634 Mcf/D), slightly lower than the prior month.
Average received wellhead prices: oil $79.81 per barrel (down from $88.13 prior month); natural gas $1.16 per Mcf (up from $0.64 prior month).
Severance and ad valorem taxes included in net profits: $0.06 million, modestly lower than the prior period.

Capital activity: $116,596 of capital expenditures reflecting tangible completion costs (including ~ $51,000 plugging costs and ~$63,000 workover costs), intangible completion costs, and a credit to tangible drilling costs; net release of reserved funds of $62,500 (release of $125,000 for workovers offset by a $62,500 ad valorem holdback).
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: PermRock Royalty Trust declares $0.0196242/unit October distribution based on July production
